# Third-party code and data of the Map tab

Loaded only by `docs/webchat/ui/tabs/map.mjs`; the engine and the world `geo.map` never import these files (AGENTS.md).

| File | What | Version | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `leaflet.mjs` | Leaflet map library, one bundled ES module with its stylesheet (built with esbuild in a temporary directory) | 1.9.4 | https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet | BSD-2-Clause |
| `countries-50m.json` | Country outlines, TopoJSON, 1:50m, with an added `cc` (ISO alpha-2) property per country | world-atlas 2.0.2 (Natural Earth) | https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas, https://www.naturalearthdata.com | Natural Earth: public domain; world-atlas: ISC |
| `places.json` | Compact lists of countries and cities for labels on the offline map | generated by `scripts/build-geo-data.mjs` | world-countries 5.1.0 (ODbL 1.0), country-json 2.3.0 (MIT), GeoNames via all-the-cities 3.1.0 (CC BY 4.0) | see `worlds/geo.map/data/README.md` |

## Attribution to show

- Outlines: Natural Earth (public domain; credit is courteous).
- Places: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org, CC BY 4.0 (credit required). The Map tab shows it in the map attribution.
- Street map layer (optional, needs internet): map tiles from OpenStreetMap, data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). The tiles are fetched from `tile.openstreetmap.org` only when the user switches to the street map; follow the tile usage policy (https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/) for any heavy or commercial embedding.
